summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement and a press release setting the record date (July 17, 2026) for an upcoming extraordinary general meeting (EGM). No details on the meeting's purpose, proposals, or any special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, strategic review) are provided. The filing is purely procedural, establishing eligibility for voting and attendance. There are no terms, valuation, premium, advisor names, or structural mechanics disclosed. This is a routine governance step, not a special-situation event. The analysis maps the HKEX announcement to its US equivalent as a Form 6-K furnishing a procedural EGM date notice.
